Searches and deletions go to Discord, while the panel receives scope details and progress without message bodies or credentials.

scripts.description: Repeatedly expanding long posts can interrupt reading on X. The script can automatically expand long posts with supported text controls. scripts.short: Show and copy Pixiv artist IDs, expose valid profile image links, and label loaded works as single, multi-page, or ugoira
scripts.description: Pixiv artist pages do not always keep IDs, profile media, and work types visible together. This script adds Pixiv copy artist ID controls, validated avatar and background links, and Pixiv single multi ugoira labels on loaded work cards. Open the panel on an artist or work page to inspect the detected context and toggle labels. It uses only profile and work information available to the current Pixiv session.

zh-CN.title: Pixiv 画师 UID、资料图片与作品类型标记

scripts.title: Product price history tracker & browsing insights for shopping sites
scripts.short: Tracks product prices you view on supported stores and shows the price trend so you can decide when to buy.
scripts.description: Deciding whether a current price is a good deal is hard without knowing the history. This script records the product prices you view on supported store pages such as AliExpress, eBay, Amazon and Lazada, and shows the price trend for those products. Open the panel from the floating button to review your browsing history and the recorded price points for each product. Price history is built from pages you actually visit and is stored locally, so it only covers products you have viewed.

zh-CN.title: 商品价格历史追踪与浏览洞察：判断最佳购买时机
zh-CN.short: 记录你在支持的购物网站浏览过的商品价格，展示价格走势，帮你判断何时购买更划算。

zh-TW.title: 商品價格歷史追蹤與瀏覽洞察：判斷最佳購買時機

scripts.title: 123pan Download Limit Unlock
scripts.short: Download large files from 123pan drive and share pages without the size limit.
scripts.description: 123pan restricts free downloads to smaller files and forces extra steps for larger ones. This script unlocks the 123pan download limit so files over 1 GB can be downloaded from your drive and share pages. It uses the official browser download flow, so the browser's own download manager keeps working. Open a file list, start a download from the userscript panel, and check the real URL or server error in the panel.

zh-CN.title: 123云盘下载限制突破
zh-CN.short: 突破123云盘1GB下载大小限制，在个人网盘和分享页直接下载大文件。

zh-TW.title: 123雲盤下載限制突破
zh-TW.short: 突破123雲盤1GB下載大小限制，在個人網盤與分享頁直接下載大檔案。

scripts.title: YouTube CPU Tamer – Reduce CPU Usage and Battery Drain
scripts.short: Reduces YouTube's CPU usage and battery drain on watch, home, embedded, and Music pages by aligning timers with the browser's rendering cycle.
scripts.description: YouTube pages keep running background timers that waste CPU and battery even when nothing is visible, so long sessions can spin fans and drain laptops. This script reduces YouTube CPU usage by rescheduling setTimeout and setInterval calls to align with the browser’s rendering frame, cutting unnecessary task execution. Install it as a userscript for Tampermonkey, Violentmonkey, or FireMonkey, then just open YouTube; no settings are needed. It works on watch, home, embedded, and YouTube Music pages in browsers that support Graphics Acceleration, while prioritizing video-related work to keep playback stable.

zh-CN.title: YouTube CPU Tamer：降低 YouTube CPU 占用与耗电
zh-CN.short: 通过把定时器与浏览器渲染帧对齐，减少 YouTube 页面后台任务执行，从而降低 CPU 占用与电池消耗。

zh-TW.title: YouTube CPU Tamer：降低 YouTube CPU 占用與耗電
zh-TW.short: 透過將計時器與瀏覽器渲染幀對齊，減少 YouTube 頁面背景任務執行，進而降低 CPU 占用與電池消耗。

scripts.title: GitHub Download Accelerator for Release, Raw and ZIP Files
scripts.short: Adds mirror download links next to GitHub release assets, raw files and ZIP archives so large files download faster without leaving the repository page.
scripts.description: Large GitHub downloads often crawl or stall when the connection to the original host is slow. This script adds a release download accelerator entry beside release assets, raw files and ZIP archives while keeping the original GitHub link available. Open the panel from the floating button to reorder mirrors, disable the ones that stopped working, or add your own proxy node. Mirror availability and speed change over time, so a failed download can be retried with another mirror from the panel. The script runs only on GitHub pages and stores your mirror list and settings in your browser.

zh-CN.title: GitHub 下载加速：Release、Raw 与 Code ZIP 镜像加速
zh-CN.short: 为 GitHub 的 Release 附件、Raw 文件与 ZIP 归档添加镜像下载入口，不必离开仓库页面即可更快下载大文件。

zh-TW.title: GitHub 下載加速：Release、Raw 與 Code ZIP 鏡像加速
zh-TW.short: 為 GitHub 的 Release 附件、Raw 檔案與 ZIP 壓縮檔加入鏡像下載入口，不必離開倉庫頁面就能更快下載大檔案。

scripts.title: GitHub Single File Quick Download from the File List
scripts.short: Adds a quick download action to every file row of a GitHub repository list so single files can be saved without opening the raw page.
scripts.description: Downloading a single file from a repository normally means opening the file, finding the raw view and saving it. This script adds a quick download action to every file row so you can download file from file list directly. The panel lets you choose direct GitHub download or a configured mirror and enables automatic fallback when a mirror fails. Folder rows are skipped, and rows whose download address cannot be derived are left untouched.

zh-CN.title: GitHub 单文件快捷下载：文件列表直接下载
zh-CN.short: 在 GitHub 文件列表的每个文件行添加快捷下载入口，无需打开文件页再找 Raw 按钮。

zh-TW.title: GitHub 單檔快速下載：檔案清單直接下載
zh-TW.short: 在 GitHub 檔案清單的每個檔案列加入快速下載入口，不必開啟檔案頁再找 Raw 按鈕。

scripts.title: GitHub Git Clone Accelerator and SSH Address Copy
scripts.short: Adds accelerated HTTPS and SSH clone addresses to the GitHub clone panel and copies a complete git clone command in one click.
scripts.description: Cloning from GitHub can be painfully slow or fail completely on unreliable connections. This script adds accelerated HTTPS and SSH clone addresses to the existing clone panel and can copy a complete git clone command with one click. Open the panel to choose HTTPS or SSH, disable clone mirrors that stopped working, or add your own proxy host. The original GitHub address always stays visible, and when clipboard access is blocked the command is shown as selectable text instead. Settings are stored in your browser and the script runs only on GitHub pages.

zh-CN.title: GitHub 克隆加速：一键复制 git clone 命令与 SSH 地址
zh-CN.short: 在 GitHub 克隆面板中提供加速的 HTTPS 与 SSH 地址，并一键复制完整 git clone 命令。

zh-TW.title: GitHub Clone 加速：一鍵複製 git clone 命令與 SSH 位址
zh-TW.short: 在 GitHub 複製面板中提供加速的 HTTPS 與 SSH 位址，並一鍵複製完整 git clone 命令。

scripts.title: GitHub Folder Download as ZIP for Any Subdirectory
scripts.short: Packages the current GitHub subdirectory into a ZIP archive in the browser so a single folder can be downloaded without cloning the whole repository.
scripts.description: Getting a single folder out of a GitHub repository usually means cloning everything or downloading the full archive. This script packages the current directory and its contents into a ZIP file directly in the browser, so you can download subdirectory content without cloning the whole repository. Open the panel to set the archive name template, size and file count limits, and the file source (direct or mirror). If some files fail, the panel lists them and lets you retry only those files. Very large directories are rejected with a clear message instead of producing a partial archive.

zh-CN.title: GitHub 文件夹打包下载：子目录一键导出 ZIP
zh-CN.short: 把当前 GitHub 子目录在浏览器内打包成 ZIP，无需克隆整个仓库即可下载该文件夹。

zh-TW.title: GitHub 資料夾打包下載：子目錄一鍵匯出 ZIP
zh-TW.short: 在瀏覽器內把目前 GitHub 子目錄打包成 ZIP，不必複製整個倉庫就能下載該資料夾。
